milestone: ATTR56: class block GET and short SET share backing storage
status: Independently accepted bounded implementation; wider hooks and full core remain partial
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; project-local binary and tests/semantics/profile.json

production.scope: Ordinary parentless CLASS public typed block GET at hook index 0 plus existing short SET at index 1, with implicit or actual typed/defaultless by-value parameter. The two real source functions/signatures share one authenticated backed property. The new header gate remains class-only at compilation and paired-origin authentication. GET retains its existing syntactic own-backing requirement; no Trait, byref/default/attribute/header, task/schema, Tick or runtime-formula expansion.

authority.compiler: Zend/zend_compile.c: zend_property_hook_uses_property makes a short SET inherently backed; zend_property_is_virtual considers all hooks. zend_compile_property_hooks preserves physical order, assigns both functions the same prop_info, rewrites the short SET to an implicit backing assignment, supplies its parameter/void return and checks variance after function compilation.
authority.runtime: Zend/zend_object_handlers.c: zend_is_in_hook compares the current function's property prototype; zend_should_call_hook also checks the receiver. zend_call_get_hook and zend_std_write_property bypass the opposite hook for same-property/receiver backing access, hold the receiver across hook execution and restore the original write value.

native_first.scope: Three original positive/static-error sources plus one Trait control pinned before implementation. Native preparation only, no differential credit.

original_sources.scope: Exact raw stdout/stderr and native exit comparison: implicit pair produces 5G116; explicit int|string pair produces S4:0;1G115S9:15;CG116S2:16;1G129S8:29;UDCS1:0;1G112D5Z through abort/retry/global receiver removal. Getter Cannot re-assign $this wins over setter variance before main output. The Trait pair remains Unsupported with zero agreement credit. Explicit 180-second model/210-second outer limits; completed with stable inputs.

strict.scope: All 448 manifest modules pass SL elaboration, algorithmic and structuring checks with main=true; exit 0, empty stderr, no timeout, 13.301 seconds and stable inputs.

independent_reached.count_note: Reported conditions include helper bindings and five harness conditions; this front adds no native agreement credit.
independent_reached.scope: Actual GET index 0/SET index 1, common property/default, distinct signatures and actual Param authenticate the source. At the fourth-call U, original STRING 8 remains in separate helper/setter cells and the outer result receipt; backing is int 29, previous result STRING 2 and count 4. Two existing captured-target/result owners retain the receiver after global removal. Missing SET function and GET-as-short-SET controls refuse. Heap/descriptor, zero-budget/full-resume equality, D-before-catch, fresh retry, count 5/result STRING 1 and final receiver retirement pass. Frozen production bytes equal 841eda1c7; SL 240-second cap, 93.604 seconds, exit 0, exact true output, empty stderr and stable fixture/source inputs.

independent_review: CLEAR for bounded semantics, physical source roles, signature/backing authority, crossed access, actual ownership/abrupt state, resumption, harness, documentation and inventory.
compatibility: The old statement-pair predicate is unchanged. The new alternative remains CLASS-only in both compiler arms and runtime pair origins, then reuses the existing short-SET compiler, signature, expression and implicit-write rules. ATTR54/55 and older accepted campaigns retain their original identities without replay.

zero_credit.outcome: At 31d9f1f14 the unchanged implicit pair is Unsupported with empty output. Incomplete, no agreement. Existing earlier failed/Unsupported/timeout cuts remain under their original identities.

environment: External packets preserve original bytes/path/cwd/profile, raw streams/exits, commands, tested revisions and stable identities. One heavy job at a time across the pair; all jobs reaped. Existing tools reused; no rebuild or portability claim.
remaining: Pure GET on an initialized property plus an inherently backed short SET is the next real producer gap and remains Unsupported. Trait, reversed/expression-GET pairs, wider headers, byref/default/attribute and Tick-bearing forms remain partial. These three sources and one front do not close the hook family. Held lanes stay unchanged; no engine bug or intentional divergence is claimed.
